title: Health Education — Grade 9-12 Learning Graph
description: A learning graph of 136 concepts covering the Grade 9-12 band of the Health Education intelligent textbook: Food and Nutrition; Human Growth, Development, and Sexual Health; Mental and Emotional Health; Personal Health and Wellness; Personal Safety and Violence Prevention; Substance Use Awareness and Prevention; and cross-cutting Skill Standards. This is the terminal band, culminating in career/college/community readiness framing and peaking cognitive demand (design, evaluate, synthesize, apply across contexts). Derived from the 2025 Minnesota K-12 Health Academic Standards, Commissioner Approved.
creator: Dan McCreary
